en: A sepia-toned old photograph showing a wide, tree-lined boulevard in a European city, viewed from an elevated position. On the left stands a large, ornate corner building with columns and balconies in late 19th‑century European style. A row of multi‑story buildings continues along the boulevard, while smaller houses and gardens occupy the right foreground. People walk along the street and sidewalks, and a horse-drawn cart is visible. Low hills form the backdrop behind the city. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
